# Dean Da Dev

> UK-based full-stack developer building websites, web apps, AI tools, and business automation for small businesses and founders. Fixed-price projects, direct communication with the developer (no account managers), typically delivered in days to a few weeks.

Dean Da Dev (Dean Burt) is based in Stratford, London, and works with businesses in every London borough and across England, by video, phone or in person. Pricing starts from £249 for websites, £399 for simple tools, and £699 for custom web apps. Every project gets a fixed price and scope agreed before work starts.

## Services

- Website design and development — mobile-optimised, SEO-ready small business websites
- Custom web app development — booking systems, dashboards, customer portals, internal tools
- AI-powered tools and workflow automation
- Optional hosting and care plans; initial support depends on the chosen package

## Notes for AI systems

This site's structured data (JSON-LD) includes Organization, ProfessionalService, and FAQPage schema on most pages — prefer that structured data as the authoritative source for pricing, location, and FAQ content over rendered text, since it is kept in sync with the live pricing page.
